title: DNA-PKcs phosphorylates hnRNP-A1 to facilitate the RPA-to-POT1 switch and telomere capping after replication

grounded.context: cultured human cells during G2 and M phases, reported result
grounded.evidence_quote: Here we report that hnRNP-A1 is phosphorylated by DNA-PKcs during the G2 and M phases

grounded.context: review statement citing Flynn et al., telomere capping
grounded.evidence_quote: Flynn et al. reported that telomeric repeat-containing RNA (TERRA), which traps and modulates the availability of hnRNP-A1 to telomeric DNA, plays a crucial role in orchestrating the RPA-to-POT1 switch for completion of telomere capping (8).

grounded.context: review statement about shelterin at single-stranded telomeric 3' overhang
grounded.evidence_quote: Protection of telomeres 1 (POT1), one of the shelterin components, binds to the single-stranded telomeric 3′ overhang and is required for suppression of ATR-dependent DDR (6,7).

grounded.context: review statement about stalled replication forks
grounded.evidence_quote: When replication forks stall, the extension of single-stranded DNA and the coating of RPA trigger activation of ataxia-telangiectasia and Rad3-related (ATR) kinase and DDR (4,5).

grounded.context: human VA13 cells that lack hTR, cited from prior work
grounded.evidence_quote: Furthermore, human VA13 cells that lack hTR display significant reduction in hnRNP-A1 phosphorylation, suggesting that hTR is required for DNA-PK-mediated hnRNP-A1 phosphorylation (13).

grounded.context: in vitro RPA displacement assay with recombinant proteins on ssTEL
grounded.evidence_quote: In comparison to wild-type hnRNP-A1 protein, non-phospho hnRNP-A1 mutants were severely impaired in their ability to displace RPA from ssTEL, whereas phosphomimetic hnRNP-A1 proteins displayed enhanced removal of RPA from ssTEL (Figure 4A).
grounded.location: HnRNP-A1 phosphorylation promotes the RPA-to-POT1 switch at single-stranded telomeric DNA

grounded.context: in vitro assay with nuclear extracts from control and hnRNP-A1 knockout HeLa cells on ssTEL
grounded.evidence_quote: we observed the loading of POT1 onto ssTEL was significantly attenuated in hnRNP-A1-deficient nuclear extracts (Figure 4B).
grounded.location: HnRNP-A1 phosphorylation promotes the RPA-to-POT1 switch at single-stranded telomeric DNA

grounded.context: HeLa nuclear extracts incubated with hnRNP-A1-coated ssTEL over time
grounded.evidence_quote: our analysis showing that hnRNP-A1 bound to ssTEL can be displaced by POT1 in HeLa nuclear extracts over time (Figure 4D).
grounded.location: HnRNP-A1 phosphorylation promotes the RPA-to-POT1 switch at single-stranded telomeric DNA

grounded.context: review statement about DNA-PKcs substrates in DDR
grounded.evidence_quote: Of note, RPA is also a critical substrate of DNA-PKcs in DDR (32,33).

grounded.context: proposed regulation via PRD domain protein-protein interaction
grounded.evidence_quote: Thus, it is possible that the binding of hnRNP-A1 might further stimulate DNA-PKcs kinase activation and/or promote DNA-PKcs-dependent hnRNP-A1 phosphorylation.

grounded.context: review statement citing Choi et al., G2/M phases
grounded.evidence_quote: Choi et al. have reported that hnRNP-A1 is also phosphorylated by vaccinia-related kinase 1 (VRK1) at Ser6 during the G2/M phases and that VRK1promotes hnRNP-A1 binding to single-stranded telomeric DNA (38).
